text_by_language.en: Light to moderate rain/snowfall (at places with an altitude of 3000 meter and above) accompanied with thunder/lightning/gusty wind (30-40kmph) is very likely to occur at isolated places over Dehradun, Tehri Garhwal, Uttarkashi, Chamoli, Pauri Garhwal, Rudraprayag, Bageshwar, Pithoragarh in next 3 hours.
